        Recently analyzed

          ⚡ Turbo mode off — not required

          Everything works without this. Turbo is optional: a free Helius RPC key (helius.dev → API Keys) just makes the feed scan ~3× more coins per refresh and enables the metadata-mutability audit. Skip it and the tool runs fine on the public RPC, only slower.

          𝕏 Monitor off

          Live X search per coin works with no setup. To also show automated recent-post counts, paste an X (Twitter) API v2 Bearer token (developer.x.com). Optional — hype is context, never proof.
